angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 918,324 km at 108.02 pc = 0.11 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 9.2577 +/- 0.0198 mas (same row, RUWE 1.04): 108.02 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.32 +/- 0.05 solar radii from Livingston et al. 2026, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of V1298 Tau c in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026Natur.649..310L/abstract): 918,324 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.1 +/- 0.05 solar masses from Livingston et al. 2026, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of V1298 Tau c in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026Natur.649..310L/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 4970 +/- 120 K from Livingston et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of V1298 Tau c in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026Natur.649..310L/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Livingston et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of V1298 Tau c in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026Natur.649..310L/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/v1298-tau.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.238, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of V1298 Tau (pscomppars): spectral type K1, from Suárez Mascareño et al. 2022 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022NatAs...6..232S/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of V1298 Tau (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.1 dex, from Suárez Mascareño et al. 2022 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022NatAs...6..232S/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of V1298 Tau (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.02045, from Suárez Mascareño et al. 2022 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022NatAs...6..232S/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of V1298 Tau (pscomppars): age 0.02 Gyr, from Livingston et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026Natur.649..310L/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of V1298 Tau (pscomppars): rotation period 2.91 d, from Finociety et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023MNRAS.526.4627F/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of V1298 Tau (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 24.77 km/s, from Johnson et al. 2022 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022AJ....163..247J/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from a blackbody at the star's published temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
